commandList.name: Undercity
rules: ICON_DUNGEON_ROOM_CURRENTSecret Entrance — When you enter this room, search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle. (Leads to Forge or Lost Well)
ICON_DUNGEON_ROOM_NEXTForge — When you enter this room, put two +1/+1 counters on target creature. (Leads to Trap! or Arena)
ICON_DUNGEON_ROOM_NEXTLost Well — When you enter this room, scry 2. (Leads to Arena or Stash)
Trap! — When you enter this room, target player loses 5 life. (Leads to Archives)
Arena — When you enter this room, goad target creature. (Until your next turn, that creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.) (Leads to Archives or Catacombs)
Stash — When you enter this room, create a Treasure token. (Leads to Catacombs)
Archives — When you enter this room, draw a card. (Leads to Throne of the Dead Three)
Catacombs — When you enter this room, create a 4/1 black Skeleton creature token with menace. (Leads to Throne of the Dead Three)

Throne of the Dead Three — When you enter this room, Reveal the top ten cards of your library. Put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield with three +1/+1 counters on it. It gains hexproof until your next turn. Then shuffle.

a39d23c0-cda0-4d19-b10b-fa0fda5a1717.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
